info.description:
REST API autentikasi: Register, Login Email, Login WhatsApp + OTP, Lupa Password + OTP.

Cara pakai:
1. Pastikan server jalan: php artisan serve (http://127.0.0.1:8000)
2. Variable: base_url, token (isi dari response login), otp (isi dari dev_otp)
3. Jalankan request berurutan per folder.

response.name: Register email duplikat (422)
Register whatsapp duplikat (422)
Register password < 8 karakter (422)
Register password tidak cocok (422)
Register field kosong (422)
Login field kosong (422)

exec: pm.test('OTP tersimpan ke variabel otp', () => { const o = pm.response.json().data.dev_otp; pm.collectionVariables.set('otp', o); pm.expect(o).to.be.ok; });

response.name: 1. Request OTP nomor terdaftar (200)

exec: pm.test('OTP tersimpan ke variabel otp', () => { const o = pm.response.json().data.dev_otp; pm.collectionVariables.set('otp', o); pm.expect(o).to.be.ok; });

response.name: 1. Request OTP email terdaftar (200)

POST logout dua kali (401) - token sudah hangus
